dct_description_sm:
Linear features representing the pipes that transport municipal sewage to the sewage treatment plant through a network of gravity mains within the City of Waterloo. Each gravity main has been drawn in the direction of flow from manhole to mahole.

Please be advised that these records are based upon available information, compiled from a variety of sources, some of which has not been verified. This is not a plan of survey, field verification is recommended.
